decisions: No new directory: every module lands beside its source in the existing src/calculator/champions package, so packages is empty. Naming src/calculator/champions here would overwrite the 172-module manifest __init__.py on --write.
BAILOUT_AUTHORITY is the only unit that moves. renata_glasc.py never reads it; support_effects.py and tests/test_renata_w_bailout.py reach it as renata_glasc.BAILOUT_AUTHORITY and retarget.

modules.docstring: The field-by-field source adjudication that keeps Bailout's lethal half withheld.
